title: The Next Psych Medicine, and Who Cannot Wait

questions.stem: Initial treatment of major depression in the 2022 VA/DoD guideline is:

options.text: Psychotherapy or a medicine, as one treatment, by patient preference

questions.explanation: The guideline recommends psychotherapy or pharmacotherapy as monotherapy, based on preference.

questions.stem: Which medicine is an acceptable opening choice?

options.text: An SSRI, an SNRI, bupropion, or mirtazapine

questions.explanation: Suggested options are not rank ordered and include an SSRI, an SNRI, bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone, vilazodone, or vortioxetine.

questions.stem: The guideline suggests against starting with:

options.text: A tricyclic, an MAOI, nefazodone, ketamine, or esketamine

questions.explanation: Those agents are not the opening move.

questions.stem: Before calling a maximized first medicine a failure, wait:
questions.explanation: The minimum adequate trial is four to six weeks after the dose is maximized.

questions.stem: Mild or moderate depression in pregnancy or while breastfeeding starts with:
questions.explanation: Evidence-based psychotherapy is first line in that setting.

questions.stem: A CIWA-Ar score under 10 is the example of:
questions.explanation: Under 10 may be supportive care, or carbamazepine or gabapentin.

questions.stem: A CIWA-Ar score of 10 to 18 is treated first with:
questions.explanation: Moderate withdrawal should receive pharmacotherapy, and a benzodiazepine is first line.

questions.stem: A CIWA-Ar score of 19 or higher, without seizure or delirium yet, is still treated first with:
questions.explanation: Severe withdrawal that is not yet complicated still uses a benzodiazepine first.

questions.stem: Benzodiazepines are first line in moderate or severe withdrawal because they:

options.text: Reduce withdrawal signs, including seizure and delirium

questions.explanation: That reduction, including seizure and delirium, is the reason.

questions.stem: A history of withdrawal seizure or delirium belongs:
questions.explanation: Complicated withdrawal is not a tomorrow appointment.
